# Lyfta

> > Lyfta is a comprehensive strength training and workout tracking app for iOS and Android, featuring 5000+ exercises, AI-powered workout generation, progress monitoring, and community features.

Lyfta helps lifters track workouts, plan training programs, and achieve body transformation goals with tools for bodybuilding, powerlifting, and general fitness. The app offers both free and premium subscription tiers with features like exercise libraries, progress analytics, and workout planning.

## Core App Features

- [Lyfta | Think Less. Lift More. Get Stronger!](https://lyfta.app): Homepage for Lyfta workout tracker & strength training app
- [Lyfta: Ultimate Lifting App](https://lyfta.app/usage/lifting-app): Lifting app for iOS/Android with workout tracking & progress monitoring
- [Lyfta Strength Training App](https://lyfta.app/usage/strength-training-app): Strength training app for iOS/Android with workout programs & tracking
- [Lyfta Fitness App](https://lyfta.app/usage/gym-app): Gym app for iOS/Android: track workouts & discover training programs
- [Choose Plan](https://lyfta.app/subscription): Lyfta Premium pricing: free trial, annual/monthly plans & features
- [Get Stronger: Explore Our Fitness Tools](https://lyfta.app/tools): Fitness tools: AI workout generator, tracker app, strength calculator

## Specialized Training Apps

- [Lyfta: Ultimate Body Transformation](https://lyfta.app/usage/body-transformation-app): Body transformation app for iOS/Android with workout tracking & programs
- [Lyfta's Ultimate Gym Tracker](https://lyfta.app/usage/gym-log-app): Gym log app for iOS/Android: track workouts, reps & progress
- [Lyfta: Premier Bodybuilding App](https://lyfta.app/usage/top-bodybuilding-app): Top bodybuilding app for iOS/Android with workout planning & tracking
- [Lyfta Bodybuilding Forum App](https://lyfta.app/usage/bodybuilding-forum-app): Bodybuilding forum app for iOS/Android with community & tracking

## Exercise Library & Guides

- [Exercise Library](https://lyfta.app/exercises): Exercise library: 5000+ exercises filtered by equipment & body part

- [Front Raise - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/front-raise-8u): Front Raise guide: dumbbell shoulder exercise for anterior deltoid

- [Landmine Romanian Deadlift - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/landmine-romanian-deadlift-98a): Landmine Romanian Deadlift: barbell hip hinge for glutes & hamstrings
- [Shrimp Squat - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/shrimp-squat-8ot): Shrimp Squat: advanced single-leg bodyweight quadriceps exercise
- [Commando Pull-up - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/commando-pull-up-9o9): Commando Pull-up guide: bodyweight back & core exercise variation
- [Lever Preacher Curl - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/lever-preacher-curl-hi): Lever Preacher Curl: machine biceps isolation exercise guide
- [Bridge - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/pod-634): Bridge exercise: bodyweight core & glute training tutorial
- [Janda Sit-up - Video Guide](https://lyfta.app/exercise/janda-sit-up-6nk): Janda Sit-up: bodyweight abdominal exercise minimizing hip flexors
